summary.name: UPDF
summary.one_liner: UPDF is an AI-powered PDF editor for reading, annotating, editing, converting, OCR-ing, and searching PDFs across Windows, Mac, iOS, Android, and the web.
use_cases: Editing text and images in PDF files
Annotating and reading PDFs on Mac
Summarizing or translating PDF content with AI
Replacing Adobe Acrobat for cheaper PDF work
summary.what_it_does: UPDF is a PDF application that covers reading, annotating, searching, editing, converting, and organizing PDF documents. Its AI Assistant can summarize, translate, and let users chat with PDF content. The page says UPDF and the AI Assistant run on Windows, Mac, iOS, and Android, with the AI also available on the web. It is listed as a free PDF editor for reading, annotating, and editing on the awesome-mac list, which links to a Mac App Store entry. The page also mentions encrypted cloud storage and backups in US and European data centers.
notable: AI Assistant that summarizes, translates, and chats with PDFs
One payment covers 4 devices across platforms
Encrypted cloud storage in US and Europe data centers
caveats: Page claims it costs about 1/6 the price of Adobe Acrobat; exact prices are not shown in the page text
Offers a free trial and a 30-day money-back guarantee, implying paid purchase is required for full use
